settings.text:
Everything we make is designed to support the moments that matter most. Because childhood isn't something to rush through—it's something to experience fully.
Family founded in 2018, we create thoughtfully-designed activewear and footwear designed to move with the best parts of the day, so we can give more time back to play.

settings.heading: Zoe and Donald
settings.mission: Our mission is to develop functional and stylish activewear tailored to the needs of children, empowering them to live an active lifestyle and explore a world of unlimited possibilities.
settings.text_1:
We are parents of three children. As a family, we love the outdoors: but we soon came to realise that activewear for children was limited to cotton t-shirts or oversized track pants. The so-called “quick dry” polyester garments were scratchy and uncomfortable – not what we want to put on the backs of our children as they embark on adventures that shape them into the people we adore.

As parents, we resonate deeply with the Montessori method by which our children were educated from a young age. We believe exploration and freedom of choice are key to teach kids to thrive on their own.
settings.text_2:
These experiences together, fueled our decision to start moodytiger with the aim to empower children in self-exploration with multifunctional and stylish activewear. The Montessori principles were precisely what characterised moodytiger: “moody” – for our unpredictable and untamed children – and “tiger” for their confidence and hunger for adventure.

As parents, we believe it is important to respect these natural, wonderful qualities of our children. They are not as fragile as we think; instead, they are fierce and daring cubs finding their roar.

settings.heading: Designed for Active Childhoods
settings.text: Every product starts with the way kids move, play, explore, and grow. We create apparel that supports active lifestyles without getting in the way.

settings.heading: Innovation for Every Adventure
settings.text: From high-performance fabrics to sport-specific functionality, we combine technology and design to help kids stay comfortable across every activity and environment.

settings.heading: Comfort Without Compromise
settings.text: Lightweight, soft, breathable, and made for unrestricted movement, our products are engineered to let kids focus on having fun, not on what they're wearing.

settings.heading: Encouraging Exploration
settings.text: We believe movement builds confidence. By inspiring children to play, discover, and embrace new experiences, we help them explore the world with curiosity and joy.
Fabrics designed for kids on the move. From school to sports, morning to night, indoor play to outdoor discovery; anywhere, everywhere, all season.
